rawFindings.title: Incorrect handling of multiple identical CLI arguments
rawFindings.explanation: Previously, if the same CLI argument was passed multiple times, the code properly overridden the value by taking the last occurrence (using argumentValue.pop()). The change removed this logic and now assigns argv[name] directly, which can be an array if multiple arguments are provided, causing options to have array values where a single value is expected.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the logic to detect if argv[name] is an array and assign only the last value to options[key].
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: When running `karma` CLI with arguments like `--port 123 --port 456`, options.port will be ['123', '456'] instead of '456', possibly causing errors or unexpected behavior when the port is used as a single integer value.
